note: Rejudged 2026-10-23 by an independent auditor (not the author) after 010e649057, which sends a synthesized withdrawal only to a destination holding an adj-out record for the route; RFC 4271 Section 3.1 allows a withdrawal only for "the IP prefix that expresses the destination for a previously advertised route". The owner approved re-fixturing these .ci (RFC-approved trailers in 010e649057). RFC 1997, Well-known Communities, NO_EXPORT (0xFFFFFF01): "All routes received carrying a communities attribute containing this value MUST NOT be advertised outside a BGP confederation boundary (a stand-alone autonomous system that is not part of a confederation should be considered a confederation itself)." Moved units: test/plugin/wellknown-no-export-egress.ci (both tags) and test/plugin/wellknown-no-export-withdraw-egress.ci. In both, the external (AS 65002) session no longer expects a withdrawal of 10.0.0.0/24; it now rejects 180A0000 in the withdrawn scope as well as the announced scope, because that session was never advertised the route. THE ASSERTION is unchanged and isolated: reject scope=announced pattern=180A0000 on the external session. Its non-vacuity controls stand: no-export-egress requires the 192.0.2.0/24 fence announced on the external session (now seq 1) and the internal (AS 65000) session must receive the 10.0.0.0/24 announcement; no-export-withdraw-egress still requires the 18C63364 withdrawal half and the fence on the external session, and the observer fixture plugin16WellknownCounts (internal/test/fixture/plugin_fixture_16.go) now demands exact counts 4 internal and 3 external, so a leaked announcement or a spurious withdrawal is an extra UPDATE and red. A bypassed gate announces and fails the reject; suppression on the wrong side fails the internal delivery; a forward-nothing build fails the fence. The Go carriers (TestForwardNoExport*, TestWellKnownNoExport*) and the interop checkNoExportBoundary are byte-identical and their judgement stands. The prior note's claim that the external session receives the refused prefix's withdrawal is superseded.
